args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary (main + subscriber companion)
args.body:
Sources: blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain and its subscriber companion (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion, accessed with team subscription code SUB-5903).

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
• Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
